title: Fake time
summary: Vitest can replace timers with a controlled clock. This makes a timer test quick and repeatable.
introduction: Vitest can replace timers with a controlled clock. This makes a timer test quick and repeatable. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Vitest can replace timers with a controlled clock. This makes a timer test quick and repeatable.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from "vitest";
test("waits for reminder", () => { vi.useFakeTimers(); try { const remind = vi.fn(); setTimeout(remind, 500); vi.advanceTimersByTime(500); expect(remind).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); } finally { vi.useRealTimers(); } });
blocks.title: Fake time

blocks.text: The fake clock reaches 500 milliseconds and triggers the reminder once.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Advance only 499 milliseconds and check no call happened.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Fake timers should be restored even when an assertion throws.
For more detail later, use this [Vitest further reading](https://vitest.dev/guide/).
